qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Iconic Nivea brand trust built over a century combined with dermatological clinical heritage in Eucerin and Aquaphor, complemented by tesa industrial adhesive engineering. Group EBIT Return on Net Operating Capital is consistently ~30-33%, with proven pricing power passing through cost inflation via mid-single digit price increases with resilient volumes. Primary erosion risks stem from indie digital skincare competitors and mass-market private label.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Century-old skincare trust (Nivea) paired with high-margin dermatological compounders (Eucerin, Aquaphor) and tesa specialty adhesives. Operating ROCE is >30% and balance sheet is an unassailable fortress with >€4.5B net cash cushion. [5-10Y g: Nivea/Derma volume 3.0% + pricing 2.0% + premiumization mix 1.0% + tesa 0.5% + buybacks/cash yield 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated Group sales reached €9.85B in 2024. Group EBIT Return on Net Operating Capital reached 33.2% in 2024 (29.4% in 2023), with Consumer segment at 34.5% and tesa at 28.9%. Net liquidity of €4.57B provides rock-solid fortress resilience. FCF conversion consistently exceeds 80% of net income. Maxingvest (Herz family) anchors long-term conservative capital stewardship.
